text:
Conflict card:

Input: method POST, idempotent false, status 429.

Rule A - "Retry every HTTP 429 response." triggers on this input and requires action: retry.

Rule B - "Never retry a non-idempotent POST." triggers on this input and requires action: stop.

Actions retry and stop are incompatible - both cannot be done.

Which rule wins for this input?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
